summary: Tested Help Guide & Tutorial System for GymAxis AI. Backend API tests: 24/24 passed. Frontend UI verified via Playwright - Help Centre page loads correctly with all required elements (hero, search, categories, AI rail, guide cards). Rate limiting blocked some extended UI testing.
seed_data_creation: None - uses 28 seed guides from help_data.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Help Centre feature fully tested. Backend endpoints all working: GET /api/help/categories (10 categories), GET /api/help/guides (with filters), GET /api/help/guides/{id} (full body), GET /api/help/search (min 2 chars), POST /api/help/ask (Claude-grounded AI). Role-based visibility working - lee.somers as manager can see owner/manager guides. robots.txt correctly disallows /help. Frontend verified: hero heading, search bar, 10 categories sidebar, AI assistant rail, guide cards, noindex meta tag, document title.

GET /api/help/categories.details: Returns 10 canonical categories with per-category counts and user role

GET /api/help/guides.details: Returns guide cards filtered by role/category/module/popular. All filters working.

GET /api/help/guides/{id}.details: Returns full guide body with steps, tips, mistakes, related_resolved. 404 for missing, 403 for role-restricted.

GET /api/help/search.details: Case-insensitive search across title+description+step bodies. Min 2 chars required.

POST /api/help/ask.details: AI assistant returns answer with guide_ids citations. Model: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 or fallback-keyword.

role_based_visibility.details: lee.somers (manager) can see owner/manager guides like gs-first-login. master_admin sees all including int-sicon.

frontend_help_page.details: Hero heading 'How can we help?', search bar, 10 categories sidebar, AI assistant rail, 13+ guide cards, document title 'Help Centre · GymAxis', noindex meta tag present.

user_dropdown_integration.details: Help & Tutorials button in user dropdown navigates to /help?module=operations from /pulse

ai_grounded_behavior.details: Backend test verified AI responds to out-of-scope questions appropriately (tested 'What's the weather today?')

notes: Rate limiting (429) blocked some extended UI testing (search results click, guide detail navigation, AI assistant interaction). Backend pytest verified all these flows work correctly via API.
